quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ
تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

parent_channels.name: P1 Calibrated Disclosure

subchannels.name: Teaching, Gathering, and Disclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A merciful source imparts knowledge; recitation gathers speech, expression discloses meaning, and sensory recognition receives it.
subchannels.active_motifs: merciful care `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; imparted knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; reading and recitation `quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`; gathered utterance and study `quranic:root_001211:B001/m01`; appearing and becoming clear `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; disclosure by speech or sign `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; perception by sight, hearing, or sensation `quranic:root_000059:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Instruction is not only the transfer of propositions. Recitation first gathers articulated material; teaching makes it known; and *bayān* opens the gathered material into an evident meaning that can be seen, heard, or inwardly detected. Mercy supplies the social and affective frame for this movement from held knowledge to intelligible expression.

subchannels.name: Celestial Signs and Reckoning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Luminous bodies rise and appear as marks whose ordered motions can be counted.
subchannels.active_motifs: sun and daylight `quranic:root_000818:B001/m01`; moon and moonlight `quranic:root_001255:B001/m01`; counting and computation `quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`; rising star `quranic:root_001475:B001/m01`; emergence into visibility `quranic:root_001475:B002/m01`; prominent guiding mark `quranic:root_001475:B006/m01`; distinguishing sign `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The sun and moon are not merely bright objects but readable motions, while the star is simultaneously a rising body and a conspicuous marker. Reckoning converts their appearance into an ordered schedule, extending the teaching-and-disclosure scene from utterance into the visible sky.

subchannels.name: Just Measure and Non-Diminution
subchannels.scene_or_process: A scale is raised and established; parties compare quantities, allot shares, and prevent commercial diminution.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical weighing and estimation `quranic:root_001645:B001/m01`; scale of justice `quranic:root_001645:B002/m01`; comparison and equivalence `quranic:root_001645:B003/m01`; proportioned creation `quranic:root_001645:B008/m01`; justice and giving the due `quranic:root_001224:B001/m01`; allotted share `quranic:root_001224:B003/m01`; straight balance `quranic:root_001224:B004/m01`; measured quantity `quranic:root_001224:B007/m01`; short measure `quranic:root_000409:B003/m01`; commercial loss `quranic:root_000409:B002/m01`; straightness and rectitude `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`; sustaining framework `quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`; equal weight `quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`; prior measuring and shaping `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 55:3 `خَلَقَ` (خ ل ق); 55:7 `مِيزَانَ` (و ز ن); 55:8 `مِيزَانِ` (و ز ن); 55:9 `أَقِيمُ` (ق و م), `وَزْنَ` and `مِيزَانَ` (و ز ن), `قِسْطِ` (ق س ط), `تُخْسِرُ` (خ س ر).
subchannels.synthesis: The balance assembles a complete transactional mechanism: an upright instrument, commensurable quantities, allotted rights, and the prohibited outcome of diminution. The creation sense of prior measuring presses the legal scene outward: just exchange imitates a world whose forms have already been proportioned.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Knowledge becomes communicable and actionable by being gathered, marked, counted, and held to a just measure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:1-9 moves from mercy, teaching, recitation, and expression to celestial reckoning and the command to maintain the balance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The lexical field treats language, celestial motion, creation, and fair exchange as different instruments of calibration: each makes an otherwise hidden order legible.

parent_channels.name: P1 Vertical Ordering and Responsive Bodies

subchannels.name: Raised Canopy and Placed Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: An overhead canopy is elevated while the lower ground is set down as a stable field of habitation.
subchannels.active_motifs: elevation `quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`; sheltering sky or roof `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; physical raising `quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`; elevation in rank `quranic:root_000582:B002/m01`; placing in a lower or assigned position `quranic:root_001657:B001/m01`; lowering in rank `quranic:root_001657:B005/m01`; ground opposite the sky `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Raising and placing establish opposed but coordinated surfaces: a sheltering upper expanse and a habitable lower field. Their lexical extensions into rank make the construction simultaneously architectural and hierarchical.

subchannels.name: Upright Growth Bending in Submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: Different vegetal bodies rise from the ground yet bend or lower themselves under a common order.
subchannels.active_motifs: stemless plant `quranic:root_001475:B003/m01`; rising or protruding form `quranic:root_001475:B002/m01`; trunked tree `quranic:root_000777:B001/m01`; prostration and submission `quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`; bending the head or body `quranic:root_000675:B004/m01`; upright bodily stance `quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`; straightness and rectitude `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The low, stemless plant and the visibly upright tree differ in structure but converge in a single action of lowering. The scene reframes prostration as the responsive motion of growth itself: elevation is completed, not contradicted, by submission.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Raised, placed, upright, and bowed forms disclose an ordered vertical relation rather than inert spatial arrangement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:6-10 places prostrating vegetation beneath a raised sky and a laid-out earth.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The stemless plant and the trunked tree become contrasting body-types that perform the same submission, while uprightness can signify both physical stance and moral rectitude.

parent_channels.name: P1 Contained Generation

subchannels.name: Fertile Ground and Edible Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Productive ground supports trees, fruit, grain, and aromatic vegetation for the earth's inhabitants.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile, well-grown earth `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; creatures dwelling on earth `quranic:root_000061:B001/m01`; fruit `quranic:root_001174:B002/m01`; palm tree `quranic:root_001483:B001/m01`; seed and cereal grain `quranic:root_000286:B001/m01`; aromatic or leafy plant `quranic:root_000609:B012/m01`; trunked tree `quranic:root_000777:B001/m01`; dense and lengthening vegetation `quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The earth is characterized by its capacity to establish and multiply growth. Tree, fruit, grain, and fragrant leaf occupy distinct roles in one food ecology, while the lexical density of vegetation makes the garden-like world a covering habitat rather than a bare inventory of produce.

subchannels.name: Husk, Envelope, and Productive Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: Plant yield is enclosed, protected, sifted, fragmented, and dispersed before becoming usable.
subchannels.active_motifs: fruit envelope and bud sheath `quranic:root_001319:B002/m01`; covering, sealing, and suppression `quranic:root_001319:B004/m01`; sieving and purification `quranic:root_001483:B002/m01`; selecting the best `quranic:root_001483:B003/m01`; grain husk and dry leaf `quranic:root_001020:B001/m01`; wind that scatters and breaks material `quranic:root_001020:B002/m01`; moving air `quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`; released scent `quranic:root_000609:B004/m01`; renewed leafing and elongation `quranic:root_000609:B017/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The palm sheath protects developing fruit, while grain reaches use through the opposite operations of breaking, winnowing, and selection. Wind is both the dispersing tool and the carrier by which the plant's scent becomes perceptible, so enclosure culminates in controlled release rather than mere concealment.

subchannels.name: Womb, Gathered Embryo, and Birth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A protected interior gathers generative matter, carries a hidden being, and releases a formed creature.
subchannels.active_motifs: female womb `quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`; womb gathering blood or fetus `quranic:root_001210:B004/m01`; gathered embryonic matter `quranic:root_001211:B003/m01`; fetus hidden in the belly `quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`; laying down a burden in birth `quranic:root_001657:B002/m01`; prior measuring `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; bringing a creature into being `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; completed bodily form `quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`; manifest human kind `quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical imagery supplies a full gestational mechanism: a womb as containing place, matter gathered within it, concealment during development, measured formation, and the laying down of the burden at birth. It materializes creation as staged care inside an enclosure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Living yield develops inside a holding form and becomes available through maturation, opening, or release.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 55:10-15 presents fertile ground, enclosed palm fruit, grain with husk, human creation, and the creation of the hidden being.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Plant envelopes, wombs, and gathered embryonic matter form parallel containers; threshing and wind expose the productive release that follows enclosure.

parent_channels.name: P1 Elemental Formation

subchannels.name: Resonant Clay Becoming Pottery
subchannels.scene_or_process: Measured clay dries into a hard, sounding body and becomes a ceramic vessel or object.
subchannels.active_motifs: ringing of hard material `quranic:root_000878:B001/m01`; dry sounding clay `quranic:root_000878:B002/m01`; ceramic and earthenware `quranic:root_001135:B006/m01`; measuring before making `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; bringing form into being `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; smooth, even surface `quranic:root_000434:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Dryness is made sensible through resonance: the material rings because it has hardened. Measuring, smoothing, drying, and firing therefore form a compact craft process beneath the surface creation statement.

subchannels.name: Moving Flame Forming the Hidden Being
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bright, mixed, restless flame supplies the material of an otherwise hidden creature.
subchannels.active_motifs: rising smokeless flame `quranic:root_001411:B003/m01`; mixing and restless disorder `quranic:root_001411:B004/m01`; fire in active motion `quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`; emitted light `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`; hidden beings `quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`; bringing a creature into being `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The flame is not a static substance: it shines, rises, mixes, and refuses stable boundaries. That mobility gives a material analogue for the hidden creature formed from it, contrasting with the hardened and audible clay body.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Distinct created forms emerge through material transformation, with sound, heat, light, and motion revealing the process.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:14-15 juxtaposes human formation from resonant clay with the hidden being's formation from a moving flame.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The material pair is acoustically and kinetically differentiated: clay announces dryness by ringing, while flame is identified by restless, luminous motion.

parent_channels.name: P2 Paired Limits and Controlled Passage

subchannels.name: Paired Horizons as Endpoints
subchannels.scene_or_process: Light rises from one directional limit and withdraws at another, establishing opposed but coordinated horizons.
subchannels.active_motifs: sunrise and eastern direction `quranic:root_000790:B001/m01`; sunset and western direction `quranic:root_001077:B006/m01`; distance and removal from home `quranic:root_001077:B007/m01`; sheltering sky `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; ground opposite the sky `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; ownership and command `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; gradual ordering and care `quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: East and west are not isolated places but terminal relations within one managed field. Rising, setting, distance, and return make the horizon pair a temporal-spatial instrument whose limits remain under a single owner.

subchannels.name: Meeting Waters Held Apart
subchannels.scene_or_process: Broad bodies of water are released toward encounter, meet at an interface, and remain restrained by a divider.
subchannels.active_motifs: broad abundant water `quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`; saline water `quranic:root_000086:B004/m01`; water-gathering depression `quranic:root_000086:B006/m01`; mixing and disturbance `quranic:root_001411:B004/m01`; instability within a place `quranic:root_001411:B005/m01`; interlaced or twisted branches `quranic:root_001411:B006/m01`; encounter of opposed participants `quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`; joining two ends `quranic:root_001372:B010/m01`; physical or conceptual divider `quranic:root_000106:B001/m01`; interval between endpoints `quranic:root_000106:B004/m01`; interspace between two things `quranic:root_000170:B002/m01`; wide separating distance `quranic:root_000170:B006/m01`; intermediate state `quranic:root_000170:B011/m01`; transgressive excess `quranic:root_000138:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 55:19 `مَرَجَ` (م ر ج), `بَحْرَيْنِ` (ب ح ر), `يَلْتَقِيَ` (ل ق ي); 55:20 `بَيْنَ` (ب ي ن), `يَبْغِيَ` (ب غ ي). No surface ayah anchor is available for `quranic:root_000106:B001` or `quranic:root_000106:B004`.
subchannels.synthesis: Encounter does not entail fusion. The two waters approach and touch within an interspace whose function is to stop transgressive overflow. Lexical images of twisting, instability, and intermediate states sharpen the pressure on the divider: it maintains difference at the exact site of contact.

subchannels.name: Hidden Depth Yielding Brilliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed object is brought out from depth and becomes visible through its own gleam.
subchannels.active_motifs: passage from an interior to the outside `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; extraction from concealment `quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`; pearl or worked gem `quranic:root_001337:B001/m01`; visible luster `quranic:root_001337:B002/m01`; flashing eye and hand display `quranic:root_001337:B004/m01`; deep red interior or depth `quranic:root_000086:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Extraction changes the epistemic state of the object: what was held in depth passes outward and announces itself by luster. The pearl therefore functions both as recovered material and as evidence made visible.

subchannels.name: Raised Vessels Underway
subchannels.scene_or_process: Constructed vessels rise above broad water, follow a navigable course, and use prominent forms as orientation.
subchannels.active_motifs: running vessel or current `quranic:root_000240:B001/m02`; rising or raised structure `quranic:root_001502:B001/m01`; created construction `quranic:root_001502:B006/m01`; first structural member `quranic:root_001502:B007/m01`; approach and getting underway `quranic:root_001502:B008/m01`; broad sea `quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`; spacious course `quranic:root_000086:B002/m01`; seafaring `quranic:root_000086:B009/m01`; mountain or landmark `quranic:root_001040:B002/m02`; gathered deep water `quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`; chief navigator `quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The maritime scene has craft, medium, motion, and orientation: a built body is raised, enters a broad course, and is read against mountain-like marks. The lexical chief of sailors adds a social role to the same governed passage.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Paired fields meet or move within assigned limits, and productive passage occurs without dissolving those limits.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:17-25 moves from paired horizons to paired seas, a separating barrier, emergent pearls, and raised vessels underway.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same geometry governs horizon, water interface, extraction, and navigation; a boundary can prevent destructive trespass while still permitting emergence and transit.

parent_channels.name: P2 Enduring Authority and Continuous Provision

subchannels.name: Passing Totality and the Remaining Face
subchannels.scene_or_process: An encompassing totality comes to an end while a visible, ranked, and honored presence remains.

subchannels.synthesis: The contrast is between exposed contingency and a presence that remains capable of sparing, reserving, covering, and governing. The face is both visible front and social rank; majesty and honor identify persistence as distinguished agency rather than bare survival.

subchannels.name: Petition and Daily Administration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dependents present needs to an owner who attends to, repairs, and carries out a changing succession of affairs.

Lordship joins ownership to incremental repair, so the scene is one of continuous administration in which changing requests are met without exhausting the remaining source.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Contingent beings pass and repeatedly need, while a distinguished authority remains and continually answers changing affairs.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:26-30 contrasts universal passing with the remaining face of majesty and honor, then depicts all in sky and earth as petitioners.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Remaining is not inert duration; lexical pardon, reserve, encompassing cover, and daily administration turn persistence into active preservation.

parent_channels.name: P3 The Closed Field of Escape

subchannels.name: Deliberate Attention to Weighty Communities
subchannels.scene_or_process: Competing activity is cleared away so focused action can turn toward two socially gathered, weight-bearing communities.
subchannels.active_motifs: clearing after occupation `quranic:root_001147:B001/m01`; pouring out a container `quranic:root_001147:B002/m01`; deliberate orientation toward a matter `quranic:root_001147:B006/m01`; physical or semantic weight `quranic:root_000202:B001/m01`; precious weight and rank `quranic:root_000202:B005/m01`; burden and slowness `quranic:root_000202:B006/m01`; impaired reception `quranic:root_000202:B009/m01`; community sharing one concern `quranic:root_001016:B013/m01`; manifest human community `quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`; hidden community `quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`.

subchannels.name: Attempted Penetration and Required Warrant

parent_channels.name: P3 Embodied Adjudication

subchannels.name: Guilt Recognized Without Interrogation

The bucket, share, and scoop imagery gives consequence a measured materiality, as though the offender receives the yield of what was accumulated.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Hidden culpability becomes legible on bodies and is converted into seizure, restraint, and consequence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:39-43 withholds questioning, identifies criminals by marks, seizes forelocks and feet, and names the denied destination.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Recognition by sign replaces testimony, while crime's lexical senses of cutting, harvesting, and earning portray guilt as material accumulated and then separated from its bearer.

parent_channels.name: P3 The Thermal Circuit

subchannels.name: Enclosing Circulation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants repeatedly move around and between bounded stations without reaching an exit.
subchannels.active_motifs: circling around a center `quranic:root_000957:B001/m01`; engulfing flood or event `quranic:root_000957:B002/m01`; night watch circling a protected place `quranic:root_000957:B005/m01`; lashed raft for crossing `quranic:root_000957:B006/m01`; fortified surrounding wall `quranic:root_000957:B010/m01`; interspace between stations `quranic:root_000170:B002/m01`; widening separation `quranic:root_000170:B006/m01`.

subchannels.synthesis: *Ḥamīm ān* is materially overdetermined as water whose heat has reached its due endpoint. The surrounding senses supply a heating vessel, a bath-like enclosure, sweat, black residue, melting matter, and decreed arrival, making the destination a completed thermal process.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Punishment is organized as repeated movement through an enclosure whose heat advances matter toward blackening, melting, and full readiness.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:44 depicts continual circling between the destination and fully heated water.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Bathhouse, heating vessel, due time, and melting fat turn the scene into an apparatus with containers, stages, and a repeated route.

parent_channels.name: P4 Garden Infrastructure and Ordered Abundance

subchannels.scene_or_process: A person anticipates a charged standing, while the promised destination takes the form of a protected, planted enclosure.

subchannels.name: Branching Canopy and Flowing Sources
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dense vegetation spreads overhead while springs emerge and maintain continuous movement through the enclosure.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fear is not only emotion but visible contraction and loss; the garden answers it with an opposite architecture of secure station, branching extension, and repeatable flow.

parent_channels.name: P4 Layered Repose and Guarded Intimacy

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Comfort and intimacy are made possible by layered interiors, bodily support, controlled sight, and a maintained boundary against prior contact.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:54-59 places reclining figures on lined beds near fruit and describes restrained gaze and untouched companions.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Textile lining, confidants, shields, tied openings, and graspable boundaries make privacy a constructed mechanism rather than an abstract condition.

parent_channels.name: P4 Recompense as Return and Yield

subchannels.name: Near Harvest and Acquired Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ripe produce remains close enough to be selected and gathered directly from its source.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering produce from its source `quranic:root_000267:B001/m01`; incurring an offense `quranic:root_000267:B002/m01`; false accusation `quranic:root_000267:B003/m01`; giving a companion the best gathered portion `quranic:root_000267:B004/m01`; edible fruit `quranic:root_001174:B002/m01`; physical nearness `quranic:root_000493:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Nearness removes the interval between source, choice, and possession. Yet the same gathering-root can describe drawing culpability onto oneself or another, making harvest a neutral mechanism whose moral quality depends on what action has been cultivated.

subchannels.name: Excellence Answered in Kind
subchannels.scene_or_process: A good act returns as a matching good, functioning as payment, substitution, or completed counter-performance.
subchannels.active_motifs: recompense for an act `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; one thing standing in for another `quranic:root_000244:B002/m01`; collection and settlement of debt `quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`; prevailing in reciprocation `quranic:root_000244:B005/m01`; desirable goodness `quranic:root_000323:B001/m01`; beneficent and well-made action `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`; utmost effort `quranic:root_000323:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Recompense is exact enough to settle an obligation yet generous enough to exceed bare justice. The repeated *iḥsān* makes deed and return mirror one another, while the debt and substitution senses specify the mechanism by which one answers for the other.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An action produces a corresponding return in the same way that a cultivated source yields fruit for gathering.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:54 brings harvest within reach and 55:60 asks whether excellence has any recompense but excellence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Harvest vocabulary carries an embedded legal reversal: *jany* can name both gathering fruit and incurring an offense, so beneficial and harmful deeds each generate their own yield.

parent_channels.name: P5 Saturated Lower Gardens

subchannels.synthesis: The list differentiates generic enjoyment, orchard fruit, the structured palm, and the singular pomegranate. Selection and ripeness senses keep the scene procedural: produce must mature and be chosen, not merely be present.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A nearer or lower garden tier is intensified through dark vegetal density, forceful water, and diverse fruit.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 55:62-69 presents another pair of gardens, dark green from saturation, with gushing springs, fruit, palms, and pomegranates.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Darkness can mark danger or an overwhelming crowd, but here it is converted into the visual index of water-rich growth; retained pools and forceful spray explain how that density is sustained.

parent_channels.name: P5 Selected Companionship in Fixed Shelter

parent_channels.name: S20. Tanning and Red-Finishing a Hide
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Tannin-bearing plant material and red resin are prepared for a hide, which is tanned, colored, coated, and repaired as its surface begins to fissure.
parent_channels.active_motifs: tannin-bearing plant `quranic:root_000076:B005/m01`; red resin and dye from a tree `quranic:root_001077:B015/m01`; tanned and reddened hide `quranic:root_000369:B004/m01`; fissuring of the hide `quranic:root_000369:B004/m02`; thick treatment used to repair leather `quranic:root_000532:B006/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The craft materializes P3's rose-red sky as a transformation of surface: plant-derived color, coating, and cracking become one unstable material state.
